classification.difficultyReason: Use the parallel relationship to find an interior supplement and the adjacent exterior angle, giving reasons.

content.prompt: Calculate $\angle EPQ$ and $\angle EPF$ giving full reasoning.

spec.description: E–P–A and D–Q–B are parallel. F–P–Q–C is a transversal. All three lines have terminal arrowheads; eight named points are marked. Single chevrons identify the parallel lines. Arcs identify FPE, EPQ and PQD.
spec.mathematics: EP is parallel to QD; angle PQD is 97 degrees. EPQ is 83 degrees and EPF is 97 degrees. Coordinates realize the given angle and parallelism.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 97-degree label is visible; calculated angles are answer content.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle EPQ+97^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle EPQ&=83^\circ\end{align*}$$
Co-interior angles between parallel lines.

$\angle EPF=97^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).
